_about: Sea step 9 dungeons (core/sea/dungeon_rules.gd, game/sea_dungeon.gd, game/sea_dungeons.gd; LOCKED: hand-made from a room kit, own space behind the door). Each dungeon is drawn from `map` (rows of cells `tile` m: '#' wall, ' ' nothing, any other letter = floor; letters in `legend` are things standing there). Kinds: arrive (where you come in), exit (the gate back out), door (open: 'key' = a key unlocks it for good, 'plates' = while every plate in `plates` is pressed by a player or a block; latch true = stays open once opened, 'lever' = while `lever` is pulled), plate, lever, block (pushed one cell away from you with interact), key (a small key for this dungeon), chest (loot table of data/sea/encounters.json). The space lies at sea coordinates space.first_x + slot x space.step_x, space.y, space.z (far off the map, above the water); a player whose sea y is over indoor_y is inside one. entrance = the gate on the island (sea x, z; yaw degrees; it finds the ground below itself). torch_every: a torch on every n-th wall cell beside a floor. env: the light inside. ALL NAMES / NUMBERS MINE. A dungeon may set its own wall_h (a tall hall: the kit's walls are stretched up, more wall over its doors). Sea step 9c: a fight (kind fight: reach_m, spawns [[x, z]], waves [[enemy ids]], notice) may raise a TIDE (tide = water level per wave over its flood cells [[x0, z0], [x1, z1]]; standing deeper than tide_hurt.from_m hurts dps_per_m per metre); doors 'clear' (fight) / 'free' (+ shut_while = shut while that fight goes on) / 'bigkey' (the Great Key, kind bigkey) / 'sealed' (never; says); a thing on a ledge says on: 'H'; `name` is only for reading. Foes climb ledges at foe_climb_speed m/s. torch_seen_m: torches farther than this from the camera are not drawn (0 = always). dress (sea step 9c-3 art pass): shares of the kit's variant floors (floor_worn, floor_mosaic) and walls (wall_crusted, wall_relief) mixed in by a steady roll per cell, clutter = share of wall-side floor cells given rubble / urns / coral (no collision; kept off doors, blocks' and plates' surroundings). Sea step 9d: outdoor = a puzzle court on its island (at = sea x, z of cell (0, 0), y = its floor), no gate; a lever with tide raises the tide (rafts, tide doors); a chest's piece goes to every player there; pieces: a chart's pieces, joined in the bag when all are in. A dungeon may set "water_color" [r, g, b, alpha] for its pits' water (sea step 13 R2d: black pitch, the Queen's dark pool, swamp water).

tool_hall.name: The Tool Hall
tool_hall._about: Sea step 9b test hall: one lane per tool (grapple over a pit to a ring; fog walkway; bramble + two braziers opening a door; a pool for ice slabs; an updraft vent up a ledge and a glide over a pit; a tide basin with rafts and a tide door; a whorl door).

fight_hall.name: The Fight Hall
fight_hall._about: Sea step 9c-1 test hall: a fight in the middle room (two waves: drowned, then a temple guard with drowned); the door behind shuts while it goes on, the door ahead opens when it is cleared.

F.notice: The hall falls quiet. A door grinds open

tidewater_temple.name: The Tidewater Temple
tidewater_temple._about: Sea step 9c-2: region 1's main dungeon, 23 rooms (hand-made plan in the diary, DECISIONS_SEA.md). Its gate stands at the back of the ruined sea temple on Coralback Reef (sea step 9c-3, tools/blender/sea_isle_reef.py GATE: island (1900, 7600) + (-10, -52), facing south).

F.notice: The hall falls still. The way on grinds open

+.notice: The tide runs out of the great hall. A door stands open

|.notice: The last of the guard falls

).name: door_sealed
).says: Sealed. Something vast turns over behind it

stackwater_court.name: The Stackwater Court
stackwater_court._about: Sea step 9d: region 1's OUTDOOR puzzle (Stackwater Rocks, tools/blender/sea_isle_puzzles.py): the sluice lever raises the tide so the raft bridges the channel; the block onto the plate opens the gate; the hook up onto the low stack, the hook across to the chest stack.

bellrock_vault.name: The Bellrock Vault
bellrock_vault._about: Sea step 9d: a small vault (Bellrock, tools/blender/sea_isle_puzzles.py): two blocks onto two plates (order matters), then the sluice lever raises the rafts across the channel to the chest.

gullhook_vault.name: The Gullhook Vault
gullhook_vault._about: Sea step 9d: a small vault (Gullhook Cay, tools/blender/sea_isle_puzzles.py): push the block through the gap for the key, unlock the door, hook across the chasm, hook up onto the ledge for the lever, down to the chest.

drowned_sanctum.name: The Drowned Sanctum
drowned_sanctum._about: Sea step 10: Abbot Shellback's arena (data/sea/bosses.json), behind The Tidewater Temple's sealed door: a round sanctum, a deep pool in the middle (the boss's), six pillars with hook rings, the boss tide T (driven by game/sea_boss.gd, not by the fight runner). No island gate: you come in through the temple's sealed door and the exit takes you back to it.

salt_cellars.name: The Salt Cellars
salt_cellars._about: Sea step 13c (diary/DESIGN_REGION1.md): Saltpan Key's mini-dungeon under the ruined salt works (its cellar stair; gate none). The drowned in the brine hall, a salt block onto a plate, the brine lever floats the raft over the vat channel to the key, the key opens the boiling vault (a fight) and the strongroom behind it. Layout mine.

F.name: fight_brine_hall
F.notice: The brine settles. Something gives way to the east

G.name: fight_boiling
G.notice: The vault falls quiet. The strongroom door swings loose

smugglers_grotto.name: Smuggler's Grotto
smugglers_grotto._about: Sea step 13c (diary/DESIGN_REGION1.md): Smuggler's Hook's mini-dungeon behind the sea cave (gate none). The smugglers hold the landing by their boat channel, a ledge chest for the Grapple Hook, the sluice-room lever opens the lookout with the stash key, the captain guards the stash. Layout mine. entrance ground = the cave floor (a ray from above would find the cave roof).

F.name: fight_landing
F.notice: The landing is yours. Their sluice room lies beyond

G.name: fight_stash
G.notice: The captain falls. The stash is yours

sunken_chapel.name: The Sunken Chapel
sunken_chapel._about: Sea step 13 R2b (diary/DESIGN_REGION2.md): Greywater Bog's mini-dungeon down the crypt stair of the sunken chapel (gate none). The drowned hold the nave, where the FOG BELL lies (chest C); a peat block onto the ossuary plate opens the crypt; the Fog Bell shows the fog walkway over the flooded crypt; the bog sluice lever floats the rafts over the channel to the key; the key opens the reliquary (a fight) and the vault behind it (T = the region's treasure chart, R2g). Layout mine.

F.name: fight_nave
F.notice: The nave is still. The ossuary door gives

G.name: fight_reliquary
G.notice: The reliquary falls quiet. The vault door swings loose

pitch_works.name: The Pitch Works
pitch_works._about: Sea step 13 R2b (diary/DESIGN_REGION2.md): The Knots' mini-dungeon down the hatch of the ruined pitch works (gate none). The EMBER GAUNTLET lies in the tar store (chest C) and burns the bramble in its doorway; pitch smugglers hold the kettle hall; the Rime Anchor (chest A) freezes slabs over the hot pitch; the gauntlet lights the two braziers that open the foreman's office, where his guards fight over the stash (T = a small chest for R2g). Layout mine.

F.name: fight_kettle_hall
F.notice: The kettle hall is yours. A stair goes down to the pitch

G.name: fight_office
G.notice: The foreman's guards are down. His stash is yours

hollow_mangrove.name: The Hollow Mangrove
hollow_mangrove._about: Sea step 13 R2c (diary/DESIGN_REGION2.md): region 2's main dungeon, 20 rooms inside the giant mangrove's roots (way in = the doorway at the foot of the trunk, island (-7900, 7900) + (0, 6); gate none). West: a bramble (Ember Gauntlet), the fog crossing (Fog Bell), the key, a hook room. East: a block onto the plate, the ghost hall fight, the key door to the GALE GLIDER, the updraft chasm (vent, ledges, glide over the pit). Then the braziers, the drowning-roots arena (rising black water, hook rings on the corner ledges), the GREAT KEY, the great door and the beacon hall with the sealed root door (the Lantern Queen's Root Crown, R2d). Layout mine.

F.notice: The root hall falls still. Roots draw back from both doors

G.name: fight_ghost_hall
G.notice: The pale crew fade. A way north smells of wind

+.notice: The black water drains between the roots. A door stands open

root_crown.name: The Root Crown
root_crown._about: Sea step 13 R2d: the Lantern Queen's arena (data/sea/bosses.json lantern_queen), behind The Hollow Mangrove's root door: the hollow inside of one giant mangrove, 19 x 19 cells: a root island in the middle, the black pool round it (hers), a ring of root walkways with three gaps, four pitch braziers on it (lit by the Ember Gauntlet; in this arena they burn out after burn_s), six root knots with hook rings in the outer water, the boss tide T (driven by game/sea_boss.gd: the enrage sinks the walkways) and four sink things h i j k (one walkway quarter each, sunk one at a time in phase 2 by game/sea_boss_lantern.gd). No island gate: you come in through the root door and the exit takes you back to it. Layout mine (/home/claude/scratch/r2_crown.py).
